author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at a very serious bill that's just become law in one of the biggest states. Our computers and the systems that power them will be subject to age verification and the slow erosion of anonymity becomes solidified. How do we counter this? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: Operating System Level Age Verification Has Passed...
